user.title: Connect your HALO internet bridge
user.description: Sign in with your HALO Home account. All commands use Avi-on cloud and your existing internet bridge. Home Assistant never connects to lamps through Bluetooth. Your password is used only to sign in.

location.title: Select your bridge location
location.description: Choose the account location containing lamps connected to your HALO bridge. The bridge must be online. The cloud API identifies a location rather than a bridge IP address.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your HALO session expired. Enter your account password to reconnect through the bridge.

error.invalid_auth: The HALO email or password was rejected.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Avi-on API, or its response is unsupported.
error.no_lights: No supported lamps with a location were found in this account.

abort.already_configured: This account location is already configured.

init.title: Bridge settings
init.description: Set how often Home Assistant reads lamp state. Use CCT presets and sliders on each device page. Existing HALO schedules remain in the phone app.
